name: startwise
description: Automation engineer's assistant for Siemens TIA Portal V21: hardware, networks, drives, field equipment, PLC blocks and HMI from plain language.
long_description:
StartWise drives Siemens TIA Portal V21 offline through the Openness API.

- Hardware from article numbers (PLC, ET 200, SINAMICS drives, HMI panels, I/O modules), PROFINET networks, HMI connections
- Drive preparation in one call: technology object, telegram, topology, control block and LAD network
- Field equipment (valves, analog measurements) with FBs, tags and networks
- SCL / LAD blocks, PLC alarms, HMI screens, compile, project archive
- Learns unknown Openness operations by itself (API search + live object explorer)

Requirements: Windows, TIA Portal V21 with STEP 7 (and Startdrive for drives), and the Windows user in the group "Siemens TIA Openness". Nothing is ever downloaded to a PLC; StartWise works offline only.

Open source (Apache-2.0): https://github.com/bilalkirtac/startwise

tia_api_dir.title: TIA Openness API folder (optional)
tia_api_dir.description: Only if TIA Portal V21 is installed in a non-standard place: the folder PublicAPI\V21\net48.
